title: HydroFabric Subsetter and Retrieval
abstract: This HydroShare resource is developed to subset and retrieve the HydroFabric dataset (Johnson, J. M. (2022), https://lynker-spatial.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/copyright.html) needed to execute the NOAA Next Generation (NextGen) Water Resource Modeling framework. The NextGen hydrofabric describes the representation, discretization, and topology of the hydrologic landscape and drainage network as a three-part data product that includes: (1) catchment and flowpath features, (2) their connectivity, and (3) the attribute sets needed to execute models. For more details about the HydroFabric data, please visit this website:  https://noaa-owp.github.io/hydrofabric/
